encode_audio_waveform: encode an audio waveform tensor into compressed latent feature frames using the DACVAE encoder
decode_encoded_frames: decode compressed latent feature frames back into reconstructed audio waveform using the DACVAE decoder
wav_idx_to_feature_idx: convert a waveform sample index to the corresponding feature frame index in the encoded representation
feature_idx_to_wav_idx: convert a feature frame index back to the corresponding waveform sample index in the original audio
pad_waveform_to_hop_length: pad an audio waveform tensor using reflect padding so its length is divisible by the encoder hop length
